title: Implement KP Article V1 RC1 through the economics exemplar
summary: Execute the approved 24-slice authoring, compiler, development-toolbar, editor, and economics migration plan through the required human checkpoint.

verificationRecords.notes: Four tests prove the accepted frontmatter, four directive names, motion after-slot, Markdown prose/list/math/refs, and absence of executable or layout-specific escape hatches.
Eight RC1 tests pass, including exact LF/CRLF offsets, UTF-16 editor positions, reversible line-column mapping, exact slicing, EOF spans, and invalid-range rejection.
Application, Node, test, Svelte, and domain type checks pass with the new immutable source primitives.
Twelve tests pass; RC1 identity and imports parse losslessly across LF/CRLF while missing, duplicate, unknown, complex, and misindented metadata fail with source spans.
All TypeScript, Svelte, and domain type checks pass with the strict build-time frontmatter parser.

Seventeen tests pass; scanner finds exact directive/attribute/body spans, preserves motion slots, ignores fenced examples, retains unknown names for validation, and rejects nesting or malformed structure.
All TypeScript, Svelte, and domain type checks pass with immutable directive and attribute scan records.
TypeScript, Svelte, and domain checks passed after index-signature-safe test accessors.

verificationRecords.scope: s06 stable identities and atomic rename
verificationRecords.notes: 29 focused tests pass, including document scoping, collision diagnostics, deterministic slug suggestions, code-safe references, and atomic rename edits.
Application, test, Svelte, and domain types pass.
34 focused tests pass, including CommonMark source spans, local-stage resolution, range addresses, invalid links, and no timeline authority for prose links.

verificationRecords.scope: s07 CommonMark and semantic reference boundary
verificationRecords.notes: TypeScript, Svelte, and domain checks pass.
39 focused tests pass for deterministic major resolution, exact lock replay, explicit updates, integrity drift, semantic export paths, and the economics release digest.
Application, test, Svelte, and domain type checks pass.
Stopped at the pre-existing unrelated reader app-to-compiler violation in fraction-composition-salience-adapter.ts, already recorded on 2026-08-08; the RC1 focused suite passes.

verificationRecords.scope: s08 production build and economics publication closure
verificationRecords.notes: Typecheck, generated economics publication freshness, and Vite production build pass.

expectedLearning: Whether four closed Markdown directives can replace three writable economics representations without source noise or learner-visible drift.
Whether one framework-neutral article IR can drive static, interactive, deck, navigation, accessibility, and editor projections.
Whether a universal development toolbar can preserve route state while remaining absent from production.
allowedWork: RC1 parser, validator, source maps, import lock, IR, static compilation, accessibility, stage manifests, deck derivation, CodeMirror language tooling and persistence, development toolbar, and economics migration.
disallowedWork: Layout, graph style, salience, choreography, arbitrary executable article code, another lesson migration, Public Web, Public Editor, SvelteKit, Canvas, WebGL, Graph3D, or animation-promotion work.
